verdict.rationale: Kling's own docs list image-to-video as a core capability, with start/end-frame conversion priced in the API and marketing about bringing still images to life. No evidence shows that the source image's subject and composition are kept in the motion output; start/end-frame anchoring only implies this. Missing for 10: documented subject/composition preservation guarantees for image-to-video, hands-on or independent corroboration of fidelity to the source image.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved

citations.quote: Kling AI specializes in text-to-video, image-to-video, and text-to-image generation using diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture.
